title: A7C II 2.01: C2 steps the rear-screen preview 3:2 -> 2:1 -> 2.4:1 in movie mode and keeps the focus frames: VDF words and the frame widgets' expected rectangle, written from appFw
ported_from: lcdcycle_v6 (A7 IV 6.02; works on that camera, F858, F969), in the form of lcdcycle_s3_v1 (A7S III 5.01; its hook, calls and transfers ran)
write_order: the patches in the listed order to apply (cave, then the hook); the reverse order to put back

triggers.0x2150006: EVENT_INPUT_KEY_TACT_CUSTOM3_ON (C3; this body has no C3 key)

cave.old_bytes: relocation entries of types [257] (257 = R_AARCH64_ABS64), applied by the loader when appFw.so is mapped and not read again
cave.why_not_after_the_segment: the first segment ends at 0x51a6cff: the 16-aligned tail of its last page is 768 bytes; the routine needs 1484

frame_rectangles.note: {x, y, w, h} u16 in a 640x480 grid, row 1 (rear panel) column 3 (16:9 picture) of the three tables; the widgets accept 5 units either way. The values are the ones that work on the A7 IV (F969)

goes_with: an A7C II open-gate state (not part of this design)
an A7C II lcdfill (fit word 0x1f8f4c = 0 and the three entries at the 3:2 rectangle; not yet built for this body): without the fill word a press does nothing
not_checked: on a camera: nothing of this design has run on an A7C II
that the key labelled C2 sends 0x2150003 (the name record is the same as on the A7 IV, where CUSTOM3 = C3 was seen on the camera)
that system mode 3 is movie on this camera (the accessor is found by call position; its field offset differs from the A7 IV's)
that dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT) finds libsencore's three functions in im.elf (the names are exported by this build's libsencore.so)
that the rear panel reports panel code 1 (3:2) and that the frame widgets use row 1 for it ([dev+0x244] non-zero, as on the A7 IV)
that the picture-ratio flag (bit 0 of its fourth argument; 1 selects 100/235) is 0 in the open-gate state, as on the A7S III
that nothing reads .rela.dyn after load on this camera (true of the glibc and musl loaders)
note: put back (level 20) removes the code; the coprocessor words stay in the mode last chosen until a cold boot. In movie mode the C2 key's assigned function no longer runs (the press is turned into the ignored event); in stills C2 is normal
